chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Junior Raglin and Jimmy Woode joining Ellington
summary: Junior Raglin was a lovable drinker who played guitar before bass; when he had to leave, Duke tried out Jimmy Woode in Boston.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
